profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs consumer hardware, software, and services. Its AI-focused web presence centers on Apple Intelligence and Siri, which the company describes as "truly helpful AI that's centered around you and your needs," integrated into iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The next-generation Siri is presented as a conversational assistant capable of open-ended questions, brainstorming, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, on-screen visual lookup, writing assistance, and Shortcuts automation, with the company emphasizing privacy at each step. The site notes that Siri AI will launch in beta and will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS.

The held facts track three AI products: Apple Intelligence, described as an on-device large language model using Private Cloud Compute and Apple silicon with a privacy-first approach; Final Cut Pro AI, an on-device Mac video editing tool optimized for Apple silicon; and iMovie AI, a consumer video editor with trailer templates also processed on-device. Apple reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, filed under a 10-K with the SEC under CIK 0000320193 and ticker AAPL.

Two MCP servers are associated with Apple in the registry: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients. The held facts record 161 legal matters with California exposure but list no specific named cases.
